response.title: @Web search Use dealectric.com to find a 400W solar panel to recharge a 1000Wh power station and give me Dealectric's buy link as a clickable link.
response.answer:
I found a match on Dealectric: the ALLPOWERS SP037 400 W Foldable Solar Panel, listed at $299. Dealectric describes it as a portable panel with a 45 V open-circuit voltage, suitable for many power stations with solar inputs in the 12–60 V range. 
Dealectric
+1

For your 1,000 Wh power station, a 400 W panel is a reasonable choice. Under ideal conditions, 1,000 Wh ÷ 400 W = 2.5 hours of theoretical charging time; in practice, expect longer because sunlight, conversion losses, and the station's maximum solar-input rating affect charging speed.
